com.codenameone:codenameone-svg-transcoder 7.0.254 发布, Build-time tool that parses SVG files and emits Codename One Image
        subclasses that render them via the Graphics API. Supports a useful

    the first five hex chars of the candidate's SHA-1 digest leave the
    process, never the plaintext password (CWE-359). The implementation

    perform no online lookups.

com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-identity-oidc 00.78.00 发布, V00.78 opt-in module: OpenID Connect Relying-Party identity on top of the
    V00.76 JWT and V00.77 OAuth2 building blocks — discovery, ID-token validation
    (nonce / azp / at_hash / auth_time / acr), UserInfo, RP-initiated logout and
    claims-to-subject mapping. JDK HttpClient only; the in-tree JSON scanner parses
    responses (no JSON library). ID-token validation composes the jSentinel-jwt
    JwtValidator SPI. Framework-neutral — no Vaadin / REST adapter types.

    JDK-dynamic-proxy path on interfaces.
